autograph hunter

His mother ran a girls\' school in Wellington, Shropshire, which may explain his reading Atalanta.

He tried a similar trick on Thomas Hardy to obtain his autograph: see Martin Ray, \'Thomas Hardy\'s Letter to Charles Hiatt\' Notes and Queries 53 (2006), 338.
